tools.what: Recompute p-values, GRIM, percentages, totals, and confidence intervals reported in a paper
cautions: A flag is an inconsistency to examine, never an accusation of misconduct

tools.what: Answer questions over a folder of PDFs with citations to the passages used
tools.reuse: yes, keep the license and NOTICE
needs: LLM and embedding API keys, or paper-qa[local] for a local embedding model
cautions: Loads its own index files with pickle: never open an index from an untrusted source

tools.what: Deep learning for molecules, materials, proteins, and drug discovery
tools.install: pip install deepchem (add [torch], [tensorflow] or [jax] for a back end)
needs: A deep learning back end; a GPU helps for training
cautions: Dataset caches use pickle: only load caches you created

tools.what: Fast interactive plots for large or live data in a Qt desktop window
tools.install: pip install pyqtgraph (plus a Qt binding such as PySide6 or PyQt6)
needs: A desktop display; does not work in a headless agent session
cautions: For figures in papers use matplotlib instead

tools.what: Free scientific icons (cells, lab equipment, organisms) as SVG, browsable at bioicons.com
tools.install: Browse bioicons.com, or take SVGs from static/icons/<license>/ in the repository
tools.license: Site MIT; each icon has its own license (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, BSD and others)
tools.reuse: per icon: cite each icon; CC-BY-SA icons make the figure share-alike
cautions: Record the author and license of every icon used

tools.what: Build or recreate scientific diagrams in the draw.io desktop app
tools.install: Read install.sh first, then follow the README (Codex plugin; needs the draw.io desktop app and Node 22+)
cautions: While running it opens a local debugging port that any local process could attach to

tools.what: 177 scientific skills: bioinformatics, statistics, chemistry, databases, writing
tools.install: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills, or copy one folder from skills/
cautions: Not every skill has tests; prefer ones with a tests/<skill> folder

tools.what: An open-source research agent (CLI and desktop) bundling about 370 skills
tools.license: Apache-2.0, with an attribution file for bundled skills
tools.reuse: yes, keep the license, NOTICE and attributions
cautions: A whole agent, not a skill to drop in; few skill-level tests

tools.install: git clone https://github.com/aipoch/medical-research-skills.git and copy one skill folder
tools.license: MIT (attribution of some K-Dense-related material is unclear)
tools.reuse: yes, after checking each skill's origin
cautions: A sampled power calculator ignores its alpha argument: check any numbers it produces against statsmodels

tools.what: Multi-agent pipeline that turns a machine learning paper into a code repository
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/going-doer/Paper2Code.git, then pip install -r requirements.txt
needs: OpenAI API key or a local vLLM model
cautions: No tests; review and run generated code in a sandbox

tools.what: Generate a presentation video (slides, speech, talking head) from a paper
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/showlab/Paper2Video.git, then pip install -r src/requirements.txt
cautions: Executes model-generated code; run in a sandbox

tools.what: Autonomous research agent that runs experiments inside Docker
tools.install: Follow the README (uv and Docker image); read the code first
tools.license: MIT declared in setup.cfg only; no LICENSE file
cautions: API-key-shaped strings are committed in the repository
Runs received shell commands; use only in an isolated container
No tests

tools.what: Curated list of about 785 AI-for-science tools, papers and datasets
tools.install: Read the README in the browser
cautions: Links are not checked automatically; some may be dead

tools.what: End-to-end automated research and paper writing
tools.license: AI Scientist Source Code License (use restrictions; not open source)
cautions: Excluded by the repository owner because of its license terms
tools.alternative: k-dense-scientific-agent-skills (its scientific-writing skill, with you writing and checking)

tools.license: AI Scientist Source Code License (use restrictions; not open source)
cautions: Excluded by the repository owner because of its license terms
Executes LLM-written code
tools.alternative: k-dense-scientific-agent-skills (its scientific-writing skill, with you writing and checking)

tools.what: List of deep learning papers in biology
cautions: Excluded by the repository owner: no license

tools.what: Chinese-first academic writing, office documents, and a scientific toolkit
tools.install: Copy one skill folder after reading it
tools.license: MIT, but bundles pdf/ and xlsx/ files marked All rights reserved (Anthropic)
tools.reuse: only its own three skills; never the bundled pdf/ or xlsx/ folders
cautions: No tests
